title: NASA’s Voyager 1 Reaches One Light-Day From Earth After Nearly 50 Years In Space
text:
NASA's Voyager 1 has become the first spacecraft to reach a distance of one light-day from Earth. Now approximately 16.1 billion miles away, the probe is so distant that a signal travelling at the speed of light takes 24 hours to reach it. NASA's Jet Propulsion Laboratory received a signal from Voyager 1 exactly a day after the milestone was reached on November 18. With commands and replies each taking 24 hours to travel, a complete exchange now spans two days.

title: USFDA issues 7 observations to NATCO Pharma's Hyderabad facility
text: NATCO Pharma Limited reported receiving seven observations from the USFDA following an inspection of its manufacturing facility. The inspection took place from November 12 to November 20 in Hyderabad. The company stated that the issued Form 483 highlights procedural observations as potential violations. NATCO Pharma expressed confidence in addressing the observations within specified timelines. The company aims to resolve these issues comprehensively and ensure compliance going forward.

title: India's position in global manufacturing heirarchy evolving rapidly: Rockwell Automation MD
text: Dilip Sawhney of Rockwell Automation said India is experiencing significant growth in its manufacturing sector. The company is expanding its operations and workforce significantly in India to integrate more fully into global value chains. Sawhney noted challenges in recruiting skilled workers despite the large population, emphasising the need for aspirational manufacturing jobs. New greenfield capacities are being developed to enhance manufacturing competitiveness for Indian industries.

The project is expected to begin soon, reviving hopes for industrialisation in the area. Chief Minister Suvendu Adhikari had previously stated discussions regarding this plant had taken place. Successive state governments have been blamed for failing to attract major industries to West Bengal.
